result.Method of Attack: Malicious setup.py installation script with Base64 encoded payload; Downloads and executes obfuscated code from a malicious URL; Drops scripts and binary executables (update.exe) to user directories; Sets registry keys and autorun for persistence; Uses techniques such as Process Hollowing, Remote Thread Injection, and Hidden Startup; Exfiltrates data via platforms like Discord and Telegram
result.Impacted Systems: Windows user systems running Python with PyPI packages
result.Attack Vector: Supply chain attack via malicious PyPI packages
result.Indicators of Compromise: Malicious URL: http://54[.]237[.]36[.]60/inject/QrvxFGKvsSJ5E5bx; Dropped file: %USER%\AppData\Local\Temp\yzulmvnb.jpg; Dropped executable: update.exe (SHA256: 618c11e03328eb0cc47ac21964479901dfaaa8a038e4145e247374169d6528f9); Dropped DLL: Rdudkye.dll (SHA256: 19e9dbfe9df33f17664e780909054b48c62d3dd66e11f31f3a657d18ac4c752f); Copied executable: %USER%\AppData\Roaming\Google\Chrome.exe; Registry autorun keys set for persistence
